dedupe_keys.name: ukraine connectivity of schools hospitals and libraries locations fibre and internet connection providers and school speed tests ministry of digital transformation 2020 to 2021

description: The Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine published three open datasets in 2020 and 2021 on the connection of public institutions to the internet, prepared for the national programme to bring optical fibre to social facilities. The schools dataset lists all schools in Ukraine with their location, whether they are connected by optical fibre, the provider, whether open wifi is available, and, in a March 2021 file of about 3 MB, internet speed test results. The hospitals dataset lists secondary care hospitals with location, internet and fibre connection and provider names, in a 1.1 MB CSV from June 2020. The libraries dataset gives the same fields for libraries, with open wifi, in a 2.3 MB workbook. Update frequencies of quarterly or half-yearly are listed, but the files have not been updated since. A regional dataset from the Chernivtsi oblast administration, updated in July 2026, gives broadband coverage of settlements in that region. Coverage: Ukraine, point locations of institutions. Format and access: CSV, XLSX and JSON on data.gov.ua, free under CC BY. Caveats: a pre-war snapshot; damage since 2022 has changed connectivity in many regions; speed tests are single measurements. Simulation uses: pre-war baseline of fibre reach to critical social facilities for Ukrainian damage and recovery scenarios. Related records: the Ukraine internet resilience case study describes wartime network behaviour; the ITU ICT statistics give national series.
name: Ukraine connectivity of schools, hospitals and libraries: locations, fibre and internet connection, providers and school speed tests (Ministry of Digital Transformation, 2020 to 2021)
notes: Metadata read through the data.gov.ua CKAN API on 2026-09-26 (package_show). Files were not downloaded; the link to the national fibre programme is inferred.
